overview: The Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board discussed a resolution on fractional zoning payments, approved its five-year action plan, and reviewed draft loan terms for the 703 Fellsway West affordable housing project.

items.title: Announcements and Introductions
items.summary: The Board officially welcomed and introduced its newest member, Rosa, to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the previous meeting.

items.title: Fractional Payment Resolution
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming presented a resolution proposing that developers make fractional payments to the Trust rather than being forced to round up to the next full affordable unit, prompting a board discussion on inclusionary zoning rules.

items.title: CPA Application Update
items.summary: Community Preservation Act Manager Theresa Dupont reported that the Trust's application for $550,000 in fiscal year 2026 funds was successfully submitted and accepted, with a presentation scheduled for November 18.

items.title: Five-Year Action Plan Update and Timeline
items.summary: The Board voted to approve the final version of the five-year affordable housing action plan, delegating final cover photo selection to Roberta Cameron, and targeted October 21 for submission to the City Council.

items.title: Medford Community Housing Loan Update
items.summary: The Board reviewed draft loan and mortgage agreements for a $100,000 loan to Medford Community Housing for the 703 Fellsway West project, requesting that legal counsel clarify cash flow definitions and correct typos.

items.title: Funding Cycles
items.summary: The Board noted that the declaration of trust already allows for applications to be accepted on a rolling basis, concluding the discussion without any further action.

items.title: Proposed Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The Board agreed to continue meeting on the first Wednesday of each month, planning an all-Zoom meeting for December 2025 and a social event for June 2026.
